from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiability(BaseModel):
    """Captures the total liability information reported in one company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as identified in the document")
    liability_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of total liabilities as reported")
    liability_unit: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported value (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    liability_line: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label associated with the liability figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyLiability]
